Transcript: Today’s topic is cognitive dissonance — a concept that’s central to understanding human decision-making. Why is this important? Because cognitive dissonance explains why people sometimes act against their own beliefs or rationalize questionable choices. At its core, cognitive dissonance refers to the psychological discomfort that arises when someone holds two or more contradictory beliefs, values, or attitudes at the same time.
